description: This file contains utility functions, data classes, constants, and import statements related to JSON parsing, color handling, error processing, and key normalization. It appears to serve as a utility module, likely supporting multiple components within the 'ai.openclaw.app' Android application, particularly in the 'node' package.

classes.name: Quad
classes.description: A generic data class representing a tuple of four elements, used for grouping four related values.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a String for safe JSON serialization and wraps it in quotes.

methods.name: asObjectOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a JsonObject if possible, or null otherwise.

methods.name: parseJsonParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject, returning null if parsing fails or input is invalid.

methods.name: readJsonPrimitive
methods.description: Retrieves a JsonPrimitive value associated with a key from a JsonObject, or null.

methods.name: parseJsonInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer value from a JsonObject by key, or null if not present or invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonDouble
methods.description: Extracts a double value from a JsonObject by key, or null if not present or invalid.

methods.name: parseJsonString
methods.description: Extracts a String value from a JsonObject by key, or null.

methods.name: parseJsonBooleanFlag
methods.description: Extracts a Boolean value from a JsonObject by key, interpreting 'true'/'false' strings.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Returns the String content of a JsonPrimitive or null if not applicable.

methods.name: parseHexColorArgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to a Long value with ARGB format, or null if invalid.

methods.name: invokeErrorFromThrowable
methods.description: Converts a Throwable into a pair of error code and message, utilizing an external parsing function.

methods.name: normalizeMainKey
methods.description: Trims a raw string and returns null if empty, otherwise returns the trimmed string.

methods.name: isCanonicalMainSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a given key string equals 'main', indicating a canonical main session key.
